source_row.rationale: Frequent hand hygiene throughout a dialysis session is important because the dialysis process involves multiple points of potential contamination given the frequent, direct vascular access required, making consistent hand hygiene at each transition point a critical infection prevention practice.
source_row.source_detail: Importance of Frequent Hand Hygiene During Dialysis
source_row.source_name: CDC — Hand Hygiene in Dialysis Settings
